query:
SELECT id AS "id!: i64", issue_id, start_utc AS "start_utc: DateTime<Utc>",
                  end_utc AS "end_utc: DateTime<Utc>"
           FROM work_blocks
           WHERE julianday(start_utc) < julianday(?) AND julianday(end_utc) > julianday(?)
           ORDER BY julianday(start_utc), id
